title: GET /podcasts currently violates the configured lint gate
reasoning: The project lint configuration enables flake8-bugbear and pycodestyle rules, and `python -m ruff check --no-cache app/api/media.py` reports B008 on the FastAPI dependency default at line 85 and E711 on the SQLAlchemy null comparison at line 90. This can block the documented lint command for the feature file even though the route behavior is otherwise straightforward. For the SQLAlchemy filter, use `.is_(None)` rather than Python `is None`, which would change the query semantics.
reproduction: Run `python -m ruff check --no-cache app/api/media.py`; the route reports B008 at app/api/media.py:85 and E711 at app/api/media.py:90.
recommendation: Either align this module with the existing project lint policy by adding accepted ignores for FastAPI dependency defaults and using `MediaFeed.deleted_at.is_(None)`, or centralize FastAPI-specific B008 ignores in Ruff configuration if that is the project convention.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: There are no linked tests for GET /podcasts, and the existing media tests exercise retry endpoints rather than lint conformance for this route.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add lint to CI for touched files or keep the existing `hatch run ruff check .` gate enforced on the media API module.
minimumFixScope: Update the GET /podcasts dependency/null-filter lint violations or the project lint configuration for this FastAPI pattern.
